_read_me: Pre-registration of the vessel-measurement and retinal-age-gap tests (vessel_associations.py).
Fill it in, set status to 'final' and the date, and COMMIT it before any AutoMorph result or
cross-fitted age prediction is opened. vessel_associations.py refuses a draft or an uncommitted
copy, and stamps every output with this file's commit hash and date.
One primary feature per disease, chosen from a published study (cite it in 'source'). Every
other feature x disease pair is exploratory: printed only with --exploratory, BH-corrected,
and never the headline. 76 metrics tested at p < 0.05 would give ~4 false hits.
The entries below are SUGGESTIONS to check against the papers, not decisions: verify each
citation, change what you disagree with, and delete this note.
Column names follow AutoMorph's csv_merge.py (zone B / zone C merged with suffixes _zone_b /
_zone_c; whole-image metrics unsuffixed). If AutoMorph spells a column differently, fixing
only the spelling is allowed: record it under 'amendments' with the date and recommit.
quality: AutoMorph M1 rule: reject = Prediction 2, or Prediction 1 with softmax_bad >= 0.25; rejected images dropped, then the patient's eyes averaged
effect: odds ratio per standard deviation of the exposure (standardised within dataset and camera), from logistic regression with the covariates below

cm_hypertension.source: arteriolar narrowing with blood pressure; e.g. Ikram et al., Hypertension 2006 (Rotterdam); Wong & Mitchell, Lancet 2007 review -- VERIFY

cm_neurodegenerative.source: reduced vascular fractal dimension in Alzheimer's disease; Cheung et al., Alzheimer's & Dementia 2014 -- VERIFY

cm_heart_disease.source: wider venules (and narrower arterioles) with coronary heart disease; McGeechan et al., Ann Intern Med 2009 meta-analysis -- VERIFY

nephropathy.source: suboptimal fractal dimension with chronic kidney disease; Sng et al., Nephrol Dial Transplant 2010 -- VERIFY

myocardial_infarction.source: McGeechan et al., Ann Intern Med 2009 -- VERIFY

aireadi._note: Measured labels. One device per run (--camera, exact string from `aireadi_dataset.py convert`): the caliber scale differs between cameras. Continuous outcomes give beta per SD; the flags give OR per SD. No sex in the public release; diabetes stage enters as three indicators (none = reference).
aireadi.camera: FILL IN: one tabletop device, then rerun with --camera for the Optomed Aurora

moca.source: lower fractal dimension with cognitive impairment; Cheung et al. 2014 -- VERIFY
